title: UBO sync polyfill takes its offset from the wrong argument, so every uniform group is written at offset 0 of the shared batch buffer
expected_finding: uniformBatchBindGroup[1] and [2] bind localUniforms at offsets 256 and 512 of the batch buffer, but the host writes all three groups' uTransformMatrix/uColor/uRound at offset 0 (the sync callback reads its offset from the null dataInt32 argument); meshes 1 and 2 read zeros and mesh 0 reads the last group's values
